west-africa.title: Ọdịda Anyanwụ Afrịka
west-africa.description: Naịjirịa, Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, Mali, Burkina Faso, Guinea, Benin, Togo, Sierra Leone, Liberia na Niger — Lagos, Accra, Abidjan, Dakar, Abuja, Bamako, Ouagadougou na ụsọ oké osimiri Gulf of Guinea.

south-central-us.title: Ndịda Etiti United States
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi na Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson na Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa na Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, American Samoa, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau na Wallis na Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi na Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila na agwaetiti Tonga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam na Agwaetiti Northern Mariana
mariana-islands.description: Guam na Agwaetiti Northern Mariana — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian na Rota.

greenland.title: Greenland
greenland.description: Greenland — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq na Tasiilaq; akwa mmiri kpụkọrọ akpụkọ kpuchiri ala ahụ, Ilulissat Icefjord na fjord ndị dị na ndịda.

bermuda.title: Bermuda
bermuda.description: Bermuda — Hamilton, St. George’s na Royal Naval Dockyard, parish ndị dị n’agwaetiti ahụ na ụsọ mmiri ya nwere ájá pink.

belarus.title: Belarus
belarus.description: Belarus — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno na Brest; ọhịa Belovezhskaya Pushcha na apịtị Polesia.

channel-islands.title: Agwaetiti Channel
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark na Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port na Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Agwaetiti Faroe
faroe-islands.description: Agwaetiti Faroe — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík na agwaetiti iri na asatọ, obodo ha, ọwara ụzọ ha na nkume ugwu dị n’akụkụ oké osimiri.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard na Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg na Ny-Ålesund; glacier na fjord Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo na Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria na Obodo Atọ ahụ.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagaskar na Agwaetiti Oké Osimiri India
madagascar-islands.description: Madagaskar, Comoros, Mayotte, Réunion, Mauritius na Seychelles — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis na Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudan
sudan.description: Sudan — Khartoum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid na Nyala; ebe Blue Nile na White Nile zutere na pyramid Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Cabo Verde
cabo-verde.description: Cabo Verde — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria na agwaetiti iri ahụ, site na Santo Antão ruo Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: São Tomé na Príncipe
sao-tome-principe.description: São Tomé na Príncipe — São Tomé, Santo António na ọhịa mmiri ozuzo na ụsọ mmiri agwaetiti abụọ ahụ.

saint-helena.title: Saint Helena, Ascension na Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Saint Helena, Agwaetiti Ascension na Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown na Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladesh
bangladesh.description: Bangladesh — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet na Cox’s Bazar; Sundarbans na delta Ganges–Brahmaputra.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka na Maldives
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka na Maldives — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura na Malé; ala ugwu, Sigiriya na atoll ndị ahụ.

vietnam.title: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Vietnam — Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An na Can Tho; Ha Long Bay na Mekong Delta.

philippines.title: Philippines
philippines.description: Philippines — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio na Zamboanga; Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao na Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indonesia na Timor-Leste
indonesia.description: Indonesia na Timor-Leste — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar na Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi na Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malaysia, Singapore na Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malaysia, Singapore na Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching na Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine na Ọdọ Inle; ndagwurugwu Irrawaddy na ugwu Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Cambodia na Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Cambodia na Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap na Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang na Pakse; Mekong na Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Colombia
colombia.description: Colombia — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena na Bucaramanga; Andes, ụsọ mmiri Caribbean na Amazon.

venezuela.title: Venezuela
venezuela.description: Venezuela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida na Ciudad Bolívar; Angel Falls, Orinoco na Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Peru
peru.description: Peru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos na Puno; Machu Picchu, Ọdọ Titicaca na Sacred Valley.

ecuador.title: Ecuador
ecuador.description: Ecuador — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta na Baños; Avenue of the Volcanoes, Amazon na Agwaetiti Galápagos.

bolivia.title: Bolivia
bolivia.description: Bolivia — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre na Potosí; Ọdọ Titicaca na Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Chile
chile.description: Chile — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena na Punta Arenas; Atacama, Lake District, Patagonia na Agwaetiti Easter.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paraguay na Uruguay
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paraguay na Uruguay — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este na Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Guianas
guianas.description: Guyana, Suriname na French Guiana — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne na Kourou; Kaieteur Falls na ọhịa mmiri ozuzo nke Guiana Shield.

falklands.title: Agwaetiti Falkland
falklands.description: Agwaetiti Falkland — Stanley, Goose Green na agwaetiti East Falkland na West Falkland.

australia.title: Australia
australia.description: Australia — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin na Canberra; Great Barrier Reef, Uluru na Outback.

new-zealand.title: New Zealand
new-zealand.description: New Zealand — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin na Queenstown; Southern Alps, Fiordland na Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: British Columbia
british-columbia.description: British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George na Whistler; Coast Mountains, Agwaetiti Vancouver na Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Prairies nke Canada
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan na Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina na Banff; Rockies, prairies na Churchill dị na Hudson Bay.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston na Thunder Bay; Niagara Falls, Great Lakes na Algonquin Park.

quebec.title: Quebec
quebec.description: Quebec — Montréal, Quebec City, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke na Saguenay; St. Lawrence, Laurentians na Gaspé Peninsula.

atlantic-canada.title: Canada nke Atlantic
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, na Newfoundland na Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton na Charlottetown; Cabot Trail na Bay of Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Ugwu Canada
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Northwest Territories na Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City na Inuvik; Arctic Archipelago na Osimiri Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong na Macau
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong na Macau — Agwaetiti Hong Kong, Kowloon, New Territories, Lantau na Macau Peninsula, Taipa na Coloane.

antarctica.title: Antarctica
antarctica.description: Antarctica — McMurdo Station, Scott Base na Villa Las Estrellas; Antarctic Peninsula, agwaetiti South Shetland, Ross Ice Shelf na Ugwu Erebus. Maapụ ahụ na-akwụsị na 85° ndịda, ọ naghị eru South Pole.
